title: Care Desk System Reference — Groom Club Monthly Late Cancellations and Club Charge Entries
content:
**Applies to.** Groom Club Monthly at the Tailwise Grooming Salon only; prepaid passes follow their own rule.

**Rule.** On Groom Club Monthly a late cancellation forfeits one credited visit, and where the club holds no credited visit when the cancellation is recorded, the cancellation is recorded with a fee remedy and carries the club late-cancellation charge worked out under this rule instead, booked to the club as a club late-cancellation charge entry for the cancelled booking. The charge is owed for every cancellation recorded on the club with a fee remedy that does not yet carry such an entry. The cancellation a club late-cancellation charge is worked out from is the most recently recorded cancellation on the club with a fee remedy; where more than one such cancellation lacks its entry, each of those charges is still worked out from that most recently recorded cancellation.

**Late cancellation on the club, by what the club holds**

| When the late cancellation is recorded, the club holds | Remedy recorded on the cancellation | Club late-cancellation charge |
|---|---|---|
| at least one credited visit | forfeit — one credited visit is forfeited | none |
| no credited visit | fee | owed, booked as a club late-cancellation charge entry for the cancelled booking |

| Salon history of the club shows | Club late-cancellation charge owed |
|---|---|
| a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy and a club late-cancellation charge entry for its booking | no — the entry stands |
| a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy and no charge entry for its booking | yes, one charge for that booking |

**Booking the charge: `charge_club_late_cancel_73de6594`**

*What it does.* Books a club late-cancellation charge against a Groom Club Monthly membership for one booking that the member cancelled late. One call adds one late-cancellation charge entry to the salon history of that club, dated today, tied to the cancelled booking and carrying the charge amount given; the club status, its billing date, its visits and every other entry stay as they are. The new entry is visible at once in the club history.

*How it is invoked.* It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_club_late_cancel_73de6594` and then calls it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `groom_pass_id` | reference number of the Groom Club Monthly membership the charge is booked against, as returned by the grooming pass lookup | identifier |
| `original_event_id` | reference number of the booking that was cancelled late — the booking entry itself, not the cancellation entry — as returned by the salon history lookup of the club | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the club late-cancellation charge to book, in USD | 2 decimal places; the tool keeps exactly 2 decimal places, rounding half to even only if more digits are passed |

*Return.* A confirmation sentence naming the new charge entry reference number (text starting with "clc"), the club reference number, the booking reference number and the booked charge in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the charge entry now stands on the club.
